import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------- data ----------------
p={"query":'(xref:panther-PTHR31126) AND (taxonomy_id:4891)',
   "fields":"accession,gene_names,organism_name,sequence","format":"json","size":500}
res=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params=p,timeout=180).json()["results"]
df=pd.DataFrame([{"acc":e["primaryAccession"],
                  "org":e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName",""),
                  "gene":";".join(g.get("geneName",{}).get("value","") for g in e.get("genes",[])),
                  "seq":e["sequence"]["value"]} for e in res])

B62_TXT="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rw=[l.split() for l in B62_TXT.strip().split("\n")]; alpha=rw[0]
B62={}
for r_ in rw[1:]:
    for j,c in enumerate(alpha): B62[(r_[0],c)]=int(r_[j+1])
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-1)

PROBE="IHCNRGKHRTGCLIGCIRKLQNW"; CYS_OFF=2; MASK={CYS_OFF,CYS_OFF+6}
def scan(seq):
    L=len(PROBE); best=(-1e9,0)
    for i in range(len(seq)-L+1):
        s=sum(sc(PROBE[j],seq[i+j]) for j in range(L) if j not in MASK)
        if s>best[0]: best=(s,i)
    return best

rows=[]
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    s=r["seq"]
    if len(s)<len(PROBE): continue
    score,i=scan(s); w=s[i:i+len(PROBE)]
    rows.append(dict(acc=r["acc"],org=r["org"],gene=r["gene"],score=score,window=w,
                     res_cat=w[CYS_OFF],res_plus6=w[CYS_OFF+6]))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows); R=R[R.score>=20].copy()

# reference windows (catalytic/invariant columns masked, so assignment is independent of C/R identity)
REF={"Siw14-like":"IHCNRGKHRTGCLIGCIRKLQNW",
     "Oca6-like" :"MHCTNGELIISLVVACMRKFSYW",
     "Oca1-like" :"VCCGMGRHRTGTVIGCLRRIMGW",
     "Oca2-like" :"VHSNKGKHRVGVVVGIIRKLLQG"}
def assign(w):
    best=(-1e9,None)
    for k,v in REF.items():
        s=sum(sc(v[j],w[j]) for j in range(len(v)) if j not in MASK)
        if s>best[0]: best=(s,k)
    return best[1]
R["subfamily"]=R.window.map(assign)

ct=pd.crosstab(R.subfamily, R.res_plus6=="R").rename(columns={True:"Arg_at_+6",False:"non-Arg_at_+6"})
ct2=pd.crosstab(R.subfamily, R.res_cat=="C").rename(columns={True:"Cys_present",False:"Cys_absent"})
print("Invariant-Arg position by P-loop subfamily (n=%d budding-yeast PTHR31126 proteins):"%len(R))
print(ct.to_string()); print()
print("Catalytic-Cys position by P-loop subfamily:"); print(ct2.to_string())

oca6=R[R.subfamily=="Oca6-like"]
print(f"\nOca6-like clade: n={len(oca6)} from {oca6.org.nunique()} species")
print("  Cys at catalytic position: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%((oca6.res_cat=='C').sum(),len(oca6),100*(oca6.res_cat=='C').mean()))
print("  Arg at +6               : %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%((oca6.res_plus6=='R').sum(),len(oca6),100*(oca6.res_plus6=='R').mean()))
print("  residues seen at +6     :", oca6.res_plus6.value_counts().to_dict())
siw=R[R.subfamily=="Siw14-like"]
print(f"\nSiw14-like clade: n={len(siw)}")
print("  Arg at +6: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%((siw.res_plus6=='R').sum(),len(siw),100*(siw.res_plus6=='R').mean()))

# Fisher exact: Arg retention Oca6-like vs Siw14-like
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
tab=[[(siw.res_plus6=='R').sum(),(siw.res_plus6!='R').sum()],
     [(oca6.res_plus6=='R').sum(),(oca6.res_plus6!='R').sum()]]
odds,p=fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\nFisher exact, Arg(+6) retention Siw14-like vs Oca6-like: table={tab}, p={p:.3e}")

# P-loop net charge (CX5R loop, 7 residues)
def netq(w): 
    core=w[CYS_OFF:CYS_OFF+7]
    return sum(1 for c in core if c in "KR") - sum(1 for c in core if c in "DE")
R["ploop_charge"]=R.window.map(netq)
print("\nMean net charge of the 7-residue CX5R loop by subfamily:")
print(R.groupby("subfamily").ploop_charge.agg(["mean","std","count"]).round(2).to_string())

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
order=["Siw14-like","Oca1-like","Oca2-like","Oca6-like"]
frac=[100*(R[R.subfamily==o].res_plus6=='R').mean() for o in order]
fracC=[100*(R[R.subfamily==o].res_cat=='C').mean() for o in order]
x=np.arange(len(order)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,fracC,w,color="#4C78A8",label="catalytic Cys present")
ax.bar(x+w/2,frac,w,color="#E45756",label="invariant Arg (+6) present")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=20); ax.set_ylabel("% of proteins")
ax.set_title("CX5R P-loop residues across budding-yeast\nPTHR31126 proteins (n=%d)"%len(R))
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(0,105)
for xi,v in zip(x-w/2,fracC): ax.text(xi,v+2,f"{v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
for xi,v in zip(x+w/2,frac): ax.text(xi,v+2,f"{v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]
dat=[R[R.subfamily==o].ploop_charge.values for o in order]
bp=ax.boxplot(dat,labels=order,patch_artist=True)
for b in bp["boxes"]: b.set_facecolor("#9ECAE9")
ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.8,ls=":")
ax.set_ylabel("net charge of 7-residue CX5R loop")
ax.set_title("P-loop electrostatics\n(substrate 5-InsP7 carries ~ -10 charge)")
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(),rotation=20)

ax=axes[2]
names=["ScOca6","ScOca1","ScSiw14 (AF)","SpSiw14","AtDSP1","HsDUSP3","ScSiw14 xtal 6BYF"]
dist=[7.54,4.89,5.05,5.17,4.88,4.70,5.70]
cols=["#E45756"]+["#4C78A8"]*6
ax.barh(range(len(names)),dist,color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(names))); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=9)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("distance, catalytic Cys SG to nearest guanidinium/ammonium (A)")
ax.axvline(5.7,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_title("Oca6 has no cationic group\nin the phosphate-binding position")
for i,v in enumerate(dist): ax.text(v+0.1,i,f"{v:.2f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
